purpose: Last ten distinct Texas House districts, HD141–150; source-based editorial certification candidates only. Current 89th House record and legislation are not a complete vote/lifetime history.
sourceCautions: All member IDs independently checked against the official House biography and current generated roster. No district-number placeholder in this cohort.
Penny Morales Shaw House biography includes 87th-session committee assignments; dated 89th committee list controls current historical profile.
Lauren Simmons HB2520 and Jo Jones HB413 are vetoed and explicitly distinguished from effective authored bills.
A bill's author role is not a personal recorded vote; archived government 89R bill-role samples are capped by source and do not establish total activity.
